concepts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a photorealistic FIRST-PERSON POINT-OF-VIEW photograph of a person HOLDING A REAL SMARTPHONE in their own left hand, looking down at its screen from their own eyes. This is a corrected presentation mockup of the attached Halovat Qibla screen.
Input image 1: existing app screen design to display on the physical smartphone, preserve its overall layout/content and short arrow. Input image 2: exact Home mosque 3D asset to preserve inside the bottom nearby-mosques button.
MANDATORY: show the actual physical phone body, hand, fingers and a little wrist OUTSIDE the phone. The viewer is the phone owner's eyes; one hand enters from bottom left, naturally grips the sides, thumb near the lower edge without covering the interface. No other person, no face, no separate person seen from behind. A screenshot by itself is NOT acceptable.
Composition: tall portrait photo, handset nearly frontal with a small natural downward tilt; the whole handset visible, large at about 76% canvas width and 83% height. Phone screen tack sharp and readable. Warm softly blurred neutral real-world background, natural daylight, subtle realistic reflections, no glare obscuring screen. Anatomically correct hand with natural skin texture.
On the real phone show the polished Halovat Qibla interface: ivory/emerald palette, native iOS SF Pro/system sans-serif fonts ONLY. Small centered Qibla title, location line 'Toshkent' and 'GPS · ±17 m'. Central realistic 3D Kaaba viewed at human eye level on a pale marble plane, small short emerald arrowhead nearby foreground; NO long path, NO long arrow shaft, NO miniature phone inside the 3D scene. Below scene '52°', 'O‘ngga buring', 'Qibla 240° · Telefon 188°', clean outlined 'Qayta sozlash'. Bottom nearby button 'Yaqin masjidlar' uses supplied 3D ivory mosque with green dome and minaret, not a line icon. At screen bottom all 5 native tabs 'Bosh sahifa', 'Namozlar', 'Tasbeh', 'Qibla', 'Profil', fourth active. Maintain these elements as in reference screen, just present the app INSIDE A PHYSICAL PHONE HELD IN A REAL HAND in FIRST PERSON.
No captions outside phone, no watermarks, no collage, no extra app features, no serif typography.

Use case: product-mockup.
Produce a premium photorealistic FIRST-PERSON CAMERA POV photo: from a user's OWN EYES looking at a SMARTPHONE THEY ARE HOLDING WITH BOTH HANDS. This is a physical phone-in-hands presentation of Halovat's Qibla app, not a standalone screen.
Input image 1: precise app UI design reference, preserve its camera-window scene layout and key content on phone display. Input image 2: actual Home 3D mosque artwork for nearby-mosques row.
CRITICAL: a real smartphone with visible thin bezel and frame, fingers and both hands MUST be visible around/below the phone, wrists entering from lower corners. First person owner's perspective, not a third-person portrait or over-the-shoulder view. No person's face or body ahead of camera. Both hands naturally cradle lower sides; thumbs rest outside display, no UI covered. Anatomically natural fingers.
Portrait photo. Phone screen large roughly 75% canvas width, complete handset inside canvas, slight three-quarter angle around 10 degrees while retaining screen legibility. Soft natural daylight, subdued blurred beige/gray background. No artificial promotional text around the phone.
The phone displays a high-fidelity Halovat Qibla screen with ivory background, emerald accents and app's native SF Pro/system sans-serif fonts. Top 'Qibla', location 'Toshkent' plus 'GPS · ±17 m'. Rounded pale mint camera-like 3D viewport contains a realistic closed black Kaaba cuboid with gold band/door at human-eye height in the distance; one SHORT SMALL EMERALD ARROWHEAD in foreground, no long trail/shaft, no phone object in app scene. Under scene a restrained '52°' next to 'O‘ngga buring', bearing 'Qibla 240° · Telefon 188°', minimal outlined 'Qayta sozlash'. Bottom 'Yaqin masjidlar' button embeds the supplied ivory mosque 3D asset with emerald dome/minaret. Native navbar always visible with 5 tabs 'Bosh sahifa', 'Namozlar', 'Tasbeh', 'Qibla', 'Profil', fourth active.
UI must live solely on the physical phone screen. Keep reference hierarchy, improve only photographic presentation. No screenshot-only result, no floating handless handset, no long arrows, no outline mosque icon, no serif fonts, no watermark, no collage.
